```bash
`r config$remote$prompt` module load 2025
`r config$remote$prompt` module load `r config$remote$modules$python`
`r config$remote$prompt` dirname "$(which python3)"
```

`module load 2025` loads EESSI 2025.06. `dirname` prints a directory under `/cvmfs/software.eessi.io` for the CPU target on that node. The directory contains `python3` and `pip3`.
